sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Zelenskyy via Ukrainska Pravda (T3) + UNN (no declared tier, attribution only)] Russia launched a combined attack on the night of 6-7 November using 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles; ALL 36 missiles were aimed at Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, with energy infrastructure the main target. Substations connecting the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine were struck in Kyiv Oblast; substations were also damaged in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts. 9 people injured incl. 1 child across the 12 attacked regions; electricity, water and heating disrupted in Kyiv; Northern Bridge damaged and closed (recorded 1100-02). [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Ukraine Air Force morning summary via Ukrainska Pravda] Air defences destroyed/jammed 4 ballistic missiles and 149 of 172 drones (117 jet-powered); hits recorded at 24 locations, debris at 10. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA), Tkachenko] 1 killed in Kyiv Oblast: a man in Brovary district died in hospital of injuries from the previous evening's attack; energy facilities hit in 3 districts; damage in 5 districts. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Russia's Defence Ministry via AFP] Moscow confirms a 'massive strike' on military-industrial, energy and transport targets in and around Kyiv. [CONTEXT] Zelenskyy: 'Russia is preparing for trilateral talks by launching ballistic missiles at Ukraine's critical infrastructure.' Abu Dhabi trilateral talks (Ukraine-Russia-US) open Tue Nov 10-11, the first trilateral engagement since February. [DEDUPE] AJ liveblog line 'death toll risen to 50' is the Komyshuvakha Nov 2 aid-point strike (toll 50 Fri, then 53), NOT this Kyiv attack -- do not merge. Kyiv city toll stays 6 injured (recorded 1300-03); Oblast 1 killed + 2 injured; national consolidated figure 9 injured incl. 1 child (Zelenskyy).
sections.what_verified: 7 distinct tiered publisher families: Reuters (T1, via GMA/Devdiscourse syndication of Reuters copy), AFP (T1, via HIT 96.7), Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA), Kyiv Independent (T2), Ukrainska Pravda (T3), Daily Sabah (T3, with agencies), Times of India (T3). UNN has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count; it is attribution only.
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Defence Ministry frames the targets as military-industrial, energy and transport infrastructure -- it confirms the strike but not the NPP-substation detail or civilian damage. No Russian comment on the Rivne/Khmelnytskyi substations specifically. Casualty figures vary slightly by outlet (8 vs 9 injured); the 9-injured consolidated figure is Zelenskyy's own, the latest available. No radiation or nuclear-safety incident reported by IAEA or Energoatom in this window.
sections.why_matters: 36 ballistic missiles in one night -- and Russia hit the substations feeding Kyiv from TWO nuclear power plants. Zelenskyy: Moscow is 'preparing' for peace talks by bombing the grid. Abu Dhabi opens in three days.

Zelenskyy: Moscow is 'preparing' for peace talks by bombing the grid. Abu Dhabi opens in three days.
